about_the_game:
QRController let's you use phone as a controller for your PC games!

Its built specifically to enable fun coop parties, with a UX experience made for the minimum friction!

1- Join the same wifi network as your laptop.
2- Scan QR Code (Will open browser on your phone)

3- Play! 

The controllers are emulated, and games on your laptop will treat them like real controllers!

The application itself is an "Admin panel". That lets the user host control how many virtual controllers exist, and which connected players are assigned to which controllers. 

Players join by scanning the join QR code, on a local network. 

 

Easy and simple, you can emulate as many controllers as you like (Tested with 16 virtual controllers connected! But no hard limit)
